title: The WO # is a link that opens the WO in the same browser tab
refs: SV-8660 (WIP spec v22 2026-08-18 Story 4 S4-R5 (+ context note))
preconds:
1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
  2. The Work In Progress report is open with rows loaded.
steps:
1. Click a row's WO # link.
  2. Confirm where the work order opens.
  3. Use the browser's back navigation.
expected:
1. For a person who has permission to open work orders, the WO # is shown as a link.
2. Clicking it opens that work order in the SAME browser tab (not a new tab).
3. The browser's back navigation returns you to the report.

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8582, read on 17 August 2026, and the Work In Progress report specification version 28 (S4-R5), read on 18 August 2026.
Last checked against build v3.8-bd246fd on 8/18/2026.
Re-checked against the live specification on 26 August 2026: the requirements this case cites are unchanged, so only the version cited above was updated.
